How Bao works

What the app does, and what it never does.
  • Nothing is a diagnosis. Bao counts what you write and shows it back. Reading a pattern is your job, and your doctor’s.
  • No ads, no tracking, no sharing. Your check-ins are never sent anywhere on their own.
  • You can leave any question empty. A short check-in still counts.
  • Delete means delete. What you remove below is gone from this device for good.
